subject: Budget range validation \r\u001A monthly spend band & procurement thresholds
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.b@redwood.com>
To: Ava Johnson <ava.j@aurorapay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Budget range validation  Redwood + Aurora (recap & next steps)

Thanks again for the time this morning, Ava  good convo on expected usage patterns and integration timeline. Quick recap and asks so we can get you a clean internal procurement signal: 

- Expected product flows: payment dispute triage and merchant support automation (short prompts + some longer context lookups)
- Current expectation: 1-3M generated tokens/month initially, with peak months up to ~6-8M during promos
- Primary procurement ask: predictable monthly spend band + minimums for procurement to approve (e.g., do they need a $50k+ annual commitment?)

Actions I promised:
1) Share a target unit economics sheet (costs to you vs target list $/1M tokens) so Samir can validate internally
2) Confirm procurement thresholds and whether a PO/contract is required for pilot
3) Share a short pricing estimate and example rollout cadence for the first 6 months

Attaching a short estimate and a one-pager on our billing cadence. Can you confirm (a) the monthly spend band you expect to sign off on (b) who on your side signs procurement approvals?

Thanks  will loop Marissa on procurement details.

 Dylan
Dylan Brooks | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Schedule: calendly.com/dylan-redwood

From: Ava Johnson <ava.j@aurorapay.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.b@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@aurorapay.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Budget range validation  Redwood + Aurora (recap & next steps)

Appreciate the recap, Dylan. Quick answers from our side: 

- Usage: your understanding is correct  1-3M tokens/mo baseline, could hit 5-7M in peak months depending on campaign cadence.
- Procurement thresholds: for anything under $25k/yr we can do a PO internally without exec approval. Above $25k and up to $100k needs director sign-off. Anything above $100k requires procurement & legal engagement (and will need a contract).
- For the pilot we want to keep spend under the $25k/yr band if possible, but if the unit economics prove out we can fast-track to the $25-100k band mid-Q3.

Samir will work on internal cost modeling once we have your $/1M token target. He is on copy.

Ava
Ava Johnson | Head of Product, Aurora Payments

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.b@redwood.com>
To: Ava Johnson <ava.j@aurorapay.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@aurorapay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 12:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Budget range validation  Redwood + Aurora (recap & next steps)

Thanks  very helpful. Two quick things from our end so Samir has the numbers he needs:

- Example unit economics (list price shown below are Redwood hosted API examples and can be optimized on Dedicated/Private deployments):
  - baseline: $800 / 1M tokens (standard model mix)
  - optimized (quantized models + batching): $350-450 / 1M tokens
  - heavy-LLM (long-context, retrieval) blended: $1,200 / 1M tokens

- If your pilot target is < $25k/yr (~<2.5M tokens at baseline price), we can scope a limited pilot that stays under procurement thresholds (e.g., capped credit + usage alerts).

I'm attaching a one-page breakdown with a couple of rollout scenarios (pilot -> expansion). Can you confirm which pricing profile Samir wants modeled (baseline vs optimized)? Also, if you can share expected monthly token distribution (month 1..6), I can produce a per-month $ estimate.

 Dylan

From: Samir Patel <samir.p@aurorapay.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.b@redwood.com>, Ava Johnson <ava.j@aurorapay.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 12:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Budget range validation  Redwood + Aurora (recap & next steps)

Thanks, Dylan. We generally want to see both baseline and optimized numbers. For procurement guidance, we need a simple matrix that shows: monthly tokens | $/month (baseline) | $/month (optimized) | cumulative annual spend.

Prelim monthly forecast for modeling (internal estimate):
- Month 1: 0.5M
- Month 2: 1.0M
- Month 3: 2.0M
- Month 4: 3.5M
- Month 5: 5.0M
- Month 6: 6.5M

Goal is to see if pilot can be structured under the $25k/yr threshold; if not, give us the clear delta to get to that band.

Samir

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.b@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.p@aurorapay.com>, Ava Johnson <ava.j@aurorapay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.m@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Budget range validation  Redwood + Aurora (recap & next steps)

Samir  thanks, this is perfect. I ran the numbers quickly against your forecast (attached full spreadsheet):

Summary (rounded):
- Baseline pricing ($800 / 1M tokens): cumulative 6-mo spend = ~$10,800 -> annualized ~ $21.6k (safe under $25k/yr)
- Optimized pricing ($400 / 1M tokens midpoint): cumulative 6-mo spend = ~$5,400 -> annualized ~ $10.8k

Interpretation: with the forecast you shared, the pilot stays under the $25k/yr procurement threshold at baseline list pricing. The main risk would be unanticipated volume spikes beyond month 6.

Recommended next steps:
1) Pilot contract: 6-month PO with a monthly cap and automated alerts at 60%/80%/100% of forecasted usage
2) Include a simple SLA and rollback/fallback plan if volumes spike (we can provide auto-throttle and model-fallbacks)
3) Marissa - can you prepare a short pilot SOW and pricing addendum we can route to Aurora procurement?

Attaching: 20260618-redwood-pricing-estimate.pdf, aurora-procurement-thresholds.xlsx (samir provided).

 Dylan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.com>
To: Ava Johnson <ava.j@aurorapay.com>, Samir Patel <samir.p@aurorapay.com>

Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 18:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Budget range validation  Redwood + Aurora (recap & next steps)

Hi Ava  looping in Procurement & Contracts to keep this moving. Per Dylan's calc, the 6-month pilot at your monthly forecast sits under ~$11k cumulative, which annualizes under the $25k threshold you mentioned.

I'll draft a short pilot SOW (6 months, monthly cap + usage alerts) and include standard Redwood T&Cs. If you can confirm billing contact and PO cadence (monthly vs quarterly), Ill prepare a DocuSign-ready packet.

Next steps:
- Ava: confirm billing contact and intended PO cadence
- Samir: confirm youre happy with baseline vs optimized modeling (we included both in the attached spreadsheet)
- Dylan: Ill share the SOW draft by EOD tomorrow

Thanks,
Marissa
